title: Treat text BPM and section instructions as soft guidance
summary: Community warning: tempo, bar counts, key changes and bracketed section cues in prose are not deterministic DAW commands; verify generated audio against targets.

build.target: Prevent agents from treating prose instructions such as exact BPM, bars or bracket tags as deterministic music commands.
requires: An exact target tempo, duration, or transition requirement
inputs: Desired hard constraints and allowed tolerance
outputs: Separated soft Suno guidance and locally enforceable hard constraints
A verification plan for any claimed timing
execute: Classify each target as a provider-guaranteed setting, soft request or local engineering requirement.
Use official tool parameter when available, not fictional prompt syntax.
Produce local timing/MIDI or DAW plan for requirements that must be exact.
If authorized, generate once and analyze beat/section timing against tolerances.
Report deviation; avoid claiming exact adherence from a prompt alone.

applies_when: An exact tempo, measure count, synchronized cue or structure matters.
avoid_when: The selected provider guarantees the exact required operation and its documented constraints suffice.

operator: Never claim hard timing from untested prose.
No credit spend without authorization; do not fabricate control support.

stop_when: The bounded test either meets tolerance or records failure.

checks: Inspect provider tool settings, timing-map uncertainty and measured output.
Retain examples where exact numeric prose was ignored.
